fusions.name: Batted Aside
fusions.desc: Swats everything in a cone 2.5 tiles long for 11 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Quiet Coshing
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It always lands as a critical hit. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Felted Mallet
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lands Square
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
